title: A higher threshold means more waiting
hook: Two stated cases: explore the accepted-offer mean and waiting tradeoff.

knows: Reading the stated arithmetic assumptions and a small numerical chart
doesNotKnow: How the accepted-offer mean and waiting tradeoff affects the stated comparison

misconception: The headline alone determines AcceptedMean, regardless of the stated inputs.
objective: Compare the accepted-offer mean and waiting tradeoff in two explicit finite cases; separate model arithmetic from an empirical population claim.
keyState: Both question and changed cases computed; both parameter/result witnesses retained.
